PROJECT PORTFOLIO

Disciplined focus.

Our current portfolio reflects a deliberate strategy: prove the model at one site before expanding. Lunga is the foundation on which everything else will be built.

Lunga · Ethiopia

Gold · Early operation entering structured professionalisation. Current priority: establish a verified production baseline and a staged development plan backed by independent technical review.

Pipeline assessment

Perpach evaluates potential opportunities through a structured screening process. No additional projects will be announced until Lunga's verification programme is substantially complete.

Expansion criteria

New projects must meet clear thresholds for geological merit, legal clarity, community context and alignment with our staged development model.

Regional focus

East Africa remains our geographic priority. We know the terrain, the regulatory environment and the communities. That knowledge is our competitive advantage.

OUR APPROACH

How we evaluate projects.

Every potential project goes through a structured screening process that prioritises geological merit, legal clarity, community context and alignment with our staged development model. We do not chase scale — we pursue quality.

The evaluation framework includes independent technical review, legal due diligence on all rights and permits, environmental baseline assessment, and community engagement mapping. Projects that pass initial screening enter a controlled diligence process with defined milestones.
